title: Penalty for quoting or publishing, etc., of non-standard units
text:
29. Penalty for quoting or publishing, etc., of non-standard units.—Whoever violates section 11

shall be punished with fine which may extend to [fifty thousand rupees for the second offence with fine
which may extend to one lakh rupees and for the third and subsequent offence with a fine which may
extend to two lakh rupees].
